scientific_limitations: Simple loopless even cycles only; odd cycles have only the identity idempotent. Published one-dimensional confinement models already have cubic-root and Gaussian range laws; the endpoint-conditioned algebraic enumeration and sharp prefactor are the distinguishing claims. Priority beyond inspected sources and independent mathematical audit remain open.
title: Exact idempotent rank spectrum and sharp stretched-exponential law for even-cycle endomorphisms
